

# tracert.exe is all Rust (tracert-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/tracert-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# tracert.cpp is replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/tracert-rust/src/tracert/tracert.rs, `rustconv
# port`); the C++ stays on disk. The target keeps a stub TU and links the Rust archive.
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(tracert_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tracert_shims PRIVATE conutils libws2_32 libiphlpapi libmsvcrt libkernel32)
target_compile_definitions(tracert_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(tracert tracert-cargo tracert.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE tracert-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS tracert_shims psdk xdk)
